task.prompt: Create an end-to-end regression notebook using sklearn.datasets.load_diabetes. Split train/test reproducibly. Fit a DummyRegressor baseline and at least two meaningful regressors (e.g. Ridge and RandomForestRegressor); compare MAE, RMSE and R2, include cross-validation on training data only, residual plots and an error-analysis table for largest absolute residuals. Discuss overfitting and feature importance where valid. Assert all metrics finite and report the best model selected using a stated criterion. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, best_model, mae, rmse, r2, baseline_rmse.
